narrative.overview: Real garment photographs carry the visual weight. Clear type and restrained green controls help the wearer inspect an explained outcome and act.
dos: Use licensed real garments and preserve provenance.
Keep examples separate from private wardrobes.
Keep deliberate focus and readable loading states.
donts: Do not claim hosted photographs stay on a phone.
Do not canonize the legacy private layouts.
Do not fabricate fit predictions or research.
